rows.en: Ah!! That's my "Tomorrow's Underwear"!!
It's important to you, isn't it? You need to keep proper hold of it.
Sorry about that, Nu Gundam.
There. Now you can rest easy.
Tomorrow's underwear and a little spare change... As long as I've got these, I can get by anywhere!
Right, Ankh!!
Don't drag me into this!!
...Well then, everyone, take care!!
Whoa, so it's finally my turn...
Zero!! You fought well. I never imagined you'd go this far.
Hmph! This much is no big deal, y'know?
Oh, that's quite the confidence!!
Figured it's about time I let the venerable Ultra Brothers get some rest.
Whaaat? Don't you get cheeky with me.
Hahaha!! I'm heading back ahead of you guys!!
Still, it's better for the young ones to be like that.
Ultraman Zero, huh... He was a good guy. I'd almost like him to come to my world too.
Hm...!? Looks like my time to go back has come too.
...No, mine as well.
Mine too...
Looks like it's all three of us at once...
Kamen Riders, Gundams... Even back in your own worlds, give your all for the sake of peace.
Yeah, of course.
It's going to get lonely.
But if we ever do meet again, that will mean... evil has returned.
That'd be bad news.
So that it never comes to that, let's each fulfill our mission.
Each in our own world.
Yeah.
Everyone...! I think it's about time for me to...
Methuss!!
Zeta, I'll go back first and wait for you.
Yeah.
Once you're back, you two get along, y'hear? You and Zeta.
It's almost time for me too... I hate to leave, but this is goodbye.
Hikari... As an engineer, you did outstanding work for us. You have my gratitude.
If anything, I'm the one who should thank all of you. It's been a fascinating experience...
Whoops, looks like it's time... Farewell.
It seems my turn has come.
Meeting all of you Kamen Riders and Gundams taught us Ultra Warriors a great many things.
I wish I could have fought alongside all of you for longer.
...Would I get scolded for saying that? After all, it's best if there's no fighting at all.
Zoffy, Taro...! We're proud to have fought alongside the Ultra Warriors too.
Yes, I'm glad we met you in this world. ...Well, it's time we got going.
I won't forget this for as long as I live... Well then...!!
...!! ...Looks like I'm next.
Everyone is fighting for peace in their own world... Just thinking that fills me with strength too.
Yes. No matter the hardship, the power of our bonds will see us through!
Once I'm back, I'll beat the Crisis Empire, no matter what!
That's the spirit. I'll defeat Shocker and win peace for my world too!
Well, this is it!! Thank you, everyone!!
...Looks like it's finally my turn.
The fighting in this world was hard, but fighting together with all of you, I came to understand.
That to face any hardship head-on and know you'll overcome it,
what matters is a heart that believes in yourself and your friends.
Exactly. When you feel like giving up, remember you've got friends who'll fight beside you.
Thank you. I'm really glad I met all of you.
If we meet again somewhere... Until then!
...It seems I'm next.
I'll never forget my memories with all of you. Even when we're apart, our hearts are one!!
Yeah. Different worlds or not, we'll always be comrades. If anything happens, I'll come running.
It was a hard fight, but I was happy to fight alongside all of you.
In each of our worlds, let's keep fighting for peace and never give in to evil!!
I swear it. On the name of the King of Hearts.
Goodbye, everyone!
...Whoa, I'm next!?
You guys... thanks for everything...!!
Too bad I couldn't show you a little more of how cool I am!!
Being cool's fine and all, but don't screw it up!
As if I'd ever screw up! I'm always at my climax right from the start!
See ya!!
See you!
Take care!!
Bye-byeee!!
Looks like we're next.
Even back home, there's a fight waiting for us.
We fight in different worlds, but we're both headed for the same thing: a peaceful future.
...I'll keep fighting. To put an end to conflict.
That is my "mission."

notes.note: 0930 #0.217-0.249 are not played by 0930.bla (it stops at TextIdOffset+44 = 0.45) and occur in no other script: unused draft of the ending farewells, which 0931 replaces. Speakers inferred from content. 0.217-0.224: OOO (0.219 thanks Nu Gundam by name; 0.223 is Ankh). 0.218/0.220 read as Nu Gundam handing back the cloth. Item name 'Tomorrow's Underwear' as in ItemNameFormal; 0.221 echoes the story_176 motto ('a little spare change').

0.228-0.235: Zero's draft farewell. 0.229/0.231/0.233/0.235 are an elder Ultra (most likely Ultraman, who remains to the end in 0931); Zero referred to as 'he' (glossary m). 0.232 'o-rekireki' = venerable/distinguished seniors, a cheeky jab at their age.
0.237 speaker unknown (uses 'ore' and 'my world', so not an Ultra); likely Nu Gundam or Rider 1.

0.238-0.249: final trio leaving at once. The final 0931 version has Nu Gundam, Rider 1 and Ultraman; 0.238 reads as Nu Gundam, 0.242 as Ultraman (mirrors 0931 #0.120), 0.243 Nu Gundam (same text as 0931 #0.121, reused 'Yeah, of course.' from story_178). Others unassigned; wording kept neutral. 0.239 'iya, watashi mo da' = 'no wait, me too'.

0931.bla verified: MessWinSetED(TextIdOffset+N) plays entry N+1 for this whole range (+0 Methuss = 0.1, +1 Zeta = 0.2 'Methuss!!', +52 Wing Zero = 0.53, +57 Wing Zero = 0.58 'mission'). Speakers: 0.1/0.3 Methuss, 0.2/0.4 Zeta Gundam, 0.5 W (Shotaro). Slice labels were all missing.
Same line as draft 0930 #0.52 (story_188); English reused.
W (Shotaro) to Methuss, who is leaving: 'when you get back, stay on good terms with Zeta'. Subject (Methuss and Zeta) restored.
Hikari 0.7, 0.9, 0.10; Rider 1 0.8 (thanking Hikari). 'Ore mo' = Hikari follows Methuss's departure.
Zoffy 0.12-0.13 and 0.18; Taro 0.14-0.15 and 0.17; Nu Gundam 0.16. 0.12 and 0.18 reuse story_188 draft lines 0930 #0.75/#0.78 (same meaning).
Taro 'sorosoro iku to shiyou': 'it's time we got going' (Zoffy and Taro leave together; Zoffy says the last goodbye).
Black RX 0.20-0.21, 0.23, 0.25; Mebius 0.22; Rider 1 0.24. 0.24 'watashi mo' (Rider 1 vs Shocker); 'for my world' added for clarity.
Zeta Gundam 0.27-0.30, 0.32-0.33; Seven 0.31. 0.29-0.30 are one sentence split across rows; English cut at the matching point.
Mebius 0.35-0.36, 0.38-0.39, 0.41; W (Shotaro) 0.37; God Gundam 0.40 (King of Hearts per glossary). Trailing source line break on 0.35 dropped.
Den-O Sword Form (Momotaros) 0.43-0.45, 0.47-0.48; Zero 0.46; then Urataros 0.49, Kintaros 0.50, Ryutaros 0.51 (one line each). 0.47 uses the glossary fixed line 'at my climax right from the start'.
Wing Zero 0.53, 0.57-0.58; Sandrock 0.54; Heavyarms 0.55; Cherudim 0.56. 0.58 bracketed 'ninmu' kept in quotes (Heero's 'mission').

report: 80/80 rows. 0931 #0.1-0.58 verified against 0931.bla (MessWinSetED offset+N -> entry N+1); slice speaker labels were all missing and are recorded in notes. 0930 #0.217-0.249 are an unplayed draft farewell (no script), speakers inferred. No identical earlier Japanese except stock lines (Methuss!!, Yeah., See ya!!, ...!!, Yeah, of course.) and story_188 draft parallels, reused. No new names.
